en_title: Battlefield 6 Devs Respond After Players Take Aim at 'Secuty' Typo and Cosmetic With 5 Pistols
cn_title: 《战地风云6》回应五枪套皮肤争议
subtitle: 刻意设计，并非失误
opus_summary: 《战地风云6》团队回应两款争议皮肤：臂章拼写错误将修复，五枪套则是刻意致敬动作电影。团队正检查品控流程，但未解释错误成因，也未回应玩家对生成式AI的质疑。

paragraphs.en: The Battlefield 6 team has responded after players took aim at a few controversial cosmetics added in Season 5.
paragraphs.cn: 《战地风云6》第5赛季新增的几款外观引发玩家批评，开发团队对此作出了回应。

paragraphs.en: Battlefield Studios took to its official Discord server to offer background information on two skins that caused a stir with the launch of Battlefield 6 Season 5 this past week (via MP1st ). The full text confirmed at least one of the issues has a fix in the works, while the other will seemingly remain the same.
paragraphs.cn: 据MP1st报道，Battlefield Studios在官方Discord服务器上发文，解释了两款争议皮肤的背景。这两款皮肤随《战地风云6》第5赛季于过去一周上线后引发了讨论。声明全文确认，团队正在着手修复其中至少一个问题，另一个似乎会维持原样。

paragraphs.en: The cosmetics – one with what appeared to be a typo in the word "security" and another featuring infantry sporting a whopping five pistol holsters – were officially added October 13 and almost immediately drew ire from fans . It's that pesky misspelling, which took the shape of the non-existent word "security" on the armband of a McNeil skin, that the developers say will be fixed when Battlefield 6 Season 5 launches in November.
paragraphs.cn: 这两款外观于10月13日正式上线，几乎立刻招来了玩家的不满：一款似乎把「security」拼错了，另一款则让步兵足足带上了五个手枪套。开发者表示，McNeil皮肤臂章上那个恼人的拼写错误，也就是原文所称并不存在的单词「security」，将在《战地风云6》第5赛季于11月上线时修复。

paragraphs.en: "You called it out clearly, and we hear your concerns," the message, acknowledging the memes and conversations surrounding the new skins, said.
paragraphs.cn: 声明提到了围绕新皮肤出现的梗图和讨论，并表示：「大家已经明确指出了问题，我们也听到了你们的担忧。」

paragraphs.en: The note continued: "To be completely frank: Items that miss the mark like this do not reflect the quality standards you expect from us, or that we set for ourselves. We take pride in the craft of our world and our gear, and seeing visual oddities slip through is frustrating for everyone. We are currently examining our internal processes and workflows to pinpoint how these issues occurred and to see how we can tighten our quality control process going forward. Thank you for holding us to high standards."
paragraphs.cn: 声明接着写道：「坦白说，这些未达预期的物品，既没有达到大家对我们的质量要求，也没有达到我们为自己设定的标准。我们为打造游戏世界和装备所付出的工艺感到自豪，看到这些视觉问题漏过检查，所有人都很沮丧。我们正在检查内部流程和工作方式，查明这些问题究竟是如何发生的，并研究今后如何加强质量管控。感谢大家始终以高标准要求我们。」

paragraphs.en: It's a quick acknowledgement – and a promise for a quick fix – that should calm some concerns in the community. The communication from BF Studios and EA, however, did not address how exactly the typo happened in the first place or if there is any merit to the new generative AI accusations launched by fans in the aftermath.
paragraphs.cn: 团队迅速承认问题，并承诺尽快修复，应该能缓解社区的部分担忧。不过，BF Studios和EA的这份声明并未解释拼写错误究竟是怎么发生的，也没有回应玩家事后提出的新一轮生成式AI指控是否属实。

paragraphs.en: 💀 BRO IS CARRYING 5 PISTOLS! WHO APPROVED THIS SKIN? 😭
paragraphs.cn: 💀这哥们带了5把手枪！这皮肤到底是谁批准的？😭

paragraphs.en: The other cosmetic that caught fans' eyes this week was the Midnight Mirage skin and its incredible five pistol holsters. It…felt like a bit much at the time, and its presence alongside the typo skin didn't do it any favors. Battlefield 6 players have kept the first-person shooter's outfits in the conversation since it launch last October, so mistake or not, an outfit like this was bound to draw some attention. As far as BF Studios is concerned, though, that design was not a mistake at all.
paragraphs.cn: 本周另一款引起玩家注意的外观是Midnight Mirage皮肤，它居然配了五个手枪套。当时看起来……确实有点过头了，又和那款有拼写错误的皮肤一起出现，处境就更不妙了。自这款第一人称射击游戏去年10月发售以来，《战地风云6》玩家一直在讨论游戏中的服装，因此，无论是不是失误，这样一套装扮都免不了引人关注。不过，BF Studios认为，这个设计根本就不是失误。

paragraphs.en: "This is an intentional creative concept—a nod to over-the-top action movie tropes where an operative inexplicably has another backup weapon strapped to every spare inch of gear," the message explained. "That said, we understand how this could look unintentional when released alongside other cosmetic anomalies."
paragraphs.cn: 声明解释道：「这是刻意采用的创意构思，致敬的是动作电影中的夸张套路：特工身上的装备只要还有一点空位，就会莫名其妙地再绑上一把备用武器。不过，我们也理解，当它和其他存在异常的外观一同推出时，大家为什么会觉得这不是有意设计的。」

paragraphs.en: That's where the conversation surrounding Midnight Mirage seems to end, so don't expect any of those pistols to be dropped anytime soon. The team then signed off promising to keep an eye on community response in the future.
paragraphs.cn: 围绕Midnight Mirage的讨论似乎就到此为止了，因此，别指望团队近期会移除其中任何一把手枪。团队在声明结尾承诺，今后会继续关注社区反馈。

paragraphs.en: "As we continue to try out new ideas to see what interests the community, you help us continue to evolve our cosmetics in Battlefield," they said. "Thank you for your continued feedback and support."
paragraphs.cn: 团队表示：「我们会继续尝试新点子，了解社区对什么感兴趣，而大家也在帮助我们不断改进《战地风云》的外观内容。感谢大家一直以来的反馈与支持。」

paragraphs.en: Battlefield 6 Season 5 launched last week and, like the seasonal content drops before it, will roll out over three waves. The first is already out and added the Vegas Strip and Area 51 maps, as well as a Dead Space crossover . New map European Casino will then arrive alongside a new event and tools come November 10. December 8 will see the addition of map updates for Blackwell Fields and New Sobek City, with more content and other changes also on the way.
paragraphs.cn: 《战地风云6》第5赛季于上周上线，与此前的赛季一样，内容将分三批推出。第一批现已上线，加入了Vegas Strip和Area 51地图，以及《死亡空间》联动内容。11月10日，新地图European Casino将与新活动、新工具一同推出。12月8日，Blackwell Fields和New Sobek City将迎来地图更新，后续还会推出更多内容和其他调整。

paragraphs.en: IGN gave Battlefield 6 multiplayer an 8/10 review . At the time, we said, "With well-layered action and dynamic destruction, Battlefield 6’s multiplayer hits in all the places where it counts most."
paragraphs.cn: IGN为《战地风云6》的多人模式打出了8分，满分10分。当时我们评价道：「凭借层次丰富的战斗和动态破坏效果，《战地风云6》的多人模式在最关键的方面都表现到位。」
